title: First Spring — EN/ES/FR (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 104bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate Spanish French language learning garden spring Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
September in Perth and the jacaranda's thinking about it
It hasn't committed yet but the purple is without doubt
Coming — and the garden's been in winter patience long enough
The first spring says that it was worth the quiet rough

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Septiembre en Perth y la jacaranda está pensando en florecer
[September in Perth and the jacaranda is thinking about flowering]
Aún no se ha comprometido pero el púrpura debe aparecer
[It hasn't committed yet but the purple must appear]
El jardín ha tenido suficiente paciencia invernal
[The garden has had enough winter patience]
La primera primavera dice que valió la pena lo estacional
[The first spring says it was worth the seasonal struggle]

[Chorus — English]
First spring, first spring
After all the winter's work you can't yet see
First spring, first spring
Coming up through the ground to meet the morning tea
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Septembre à Perth et le jacaranda pense à fleurir
[September in Perth and the jacaranda thinks about flowering]
Il ne s'est pas encore décidé mais le violet va bientôt venir
[It hasn't decided yet but the purple will soon come]
Le jardin a eu assez de patience en hiver
[The garden has had enough patience in winter]
Le premier printemps dit que c'était la peine — l'air
[The first spring says it was worth it — the air]

[Outro — All three languages]
First spring… La primera primavera… Le premier printemps
Coming up through the ground — Subiendo a través de la tierra — Montant à travers la terre
The gardens still growing
